items.title: Ernest McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: The interviewee (Ernest McLean) does not speak in the provided transcript. The interviewer mentions Louis Dumaine and states 'I knew him', but there is no evidence from the interviewee regarding a personal relationship.

ctx.x: There's a, what's the boy name, I can't think of his name. He used to play trumpet and now he started playing bass and he was a good drummer. What is the, I called his name after that. And this is Dijon, Dijon they called him. Yeah, that's, can you see it? Yeah. You know who that is? Wait a minute.

Yeah, I knew him right now, Louis Dumaine. Now, this is Josh Johnson. Son Johnson we ought to call him. Yeah. And this, that, this is another Johnson, what's the, call his name, I can't think of his name. It's Eddie Johnson. Eddie Johnson, that's right. Oh yeah. Howard Davis. You know Howard Davis?
